items.quote: 18:1 And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
items.claim: The text says the LORD spoke to Moses. This opens a speech to him.

items.quote: 18:2 Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am the LORD your God.
items.claim: The text says Moses is told to pass a message to the children of Israel: "I am the LORD your God." This names the LORD as their God.
